applicability: The reviewer opened with no subject, when the subject catalogue answers after the bounded first-read wait (SUBJECT_HOLD_MS) has already released the task-context read.
conditions: A reader gesture is a pointerdown, keydown, wheel or touchstart observed passively on the surface root.
Engagement is ignored while the hold is still settling, and never overwrites an explicit selection made by the same gesture.
exclusions: A catalogue that answers within the bounded wait, which selects its first subject as before.
statement: When the subject catalogue answers after the bounded first-read wait, a reader who has acted in the reviewer (pointer, key, wheel or touch) keeps the subject, view and focus they have and the catalogue only fills the navigation; a reader who has not acted is landed on the first family in the same mounted workspace.
